iconography.realia_identification: Striding male human figure in Minoan loincloth
iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Pedestrian / Walking Youth.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/da/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 01 (Pedestrian / Walking Youth) depicts Striding male human figure in Minoan loincloth. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_001 and Linear A AB01. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/da/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 01): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Pedestrian / Walking Youth) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/da/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
